summary: Form I-90, “Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card”, is the form you file with USCIS to renew a green card that has expired or will expire within six months, or to replace one that was lost, stolen, damaged, never received or has wrong information. You fill it in yourself if you are a permanent resident; a parent or legal guardian may sign for a child under 14.
